methodology: Pipeline simulation: verifier.py loaded directly with mock copy_from_env injecting synthetic result JSONs. Two do-nothing scenarios tested per Lesson 24.

do_nothing_no_export.description: copy_from_env raises FileNotFoundError (agent did nothing, export never ran)

do_nothing_baseline.description: Export ran but all fields at initial state (no new workspaces, no new layers, no layer group)

partial_one_workspace_one_layer.description: One workspace (infrastructure) and one layer (settlements) created, but no second workspace, no waterways layer, no SLDs, no layer group

full_success.description: All criteria met: infrastructure + environment workspaces + 2 PostGIS datastores + settlements + waterways layers + settlement_marker + waterway_line SLDs + regional_portal layer group

score_cap_gate: If both settlements AND waterways layers are absent and score >= 65, score capped to 64. Layers are the core deliverable.
notes: Layer name matching is flexible: 'settl'/'populated'/'cities' for settlements; 'water'/'river' for waterways. SLD search checks both workspace-scoped and global scope. Layer group name must contain 'regional'/'portal'.
verification_method: export_result.sh -> /tmp/multi_workspace_portal_result.json -> copy_from_env -> JSON field parsing, flexible name matching for layers/SLDs
